families.10: Program identity (emblem, city map, micrographics, textures)

components.name: base
components.summary: Opt-in base layer under .vk, focus ring, .vk-icon, type/surface/layout utilities, .vk-cut chamfer, .vk-glass.
components.api: CSS only

components.name: core
components.summary: VK namespace: el(), icon(), uid(), emitter(), fire(), place() popover positioning, token(), fold(), rng().
components.api: VK.el, VK.icon, VK.place, VK.token, VK.fold, VK.rng, VK.reducedMotion

components.name: focus
components.summary: Keyboard plumbing: roving tabindex, focus trap, Shift+Arrow region hopping ([data-vk-hop]).
components.api: VK.focus.roving(el, opts), VK.focus.trap(el, opts), VK.focus.enableHop()

components.name: actions
components.summary: The one action registry: palette, menus, toolbars, status bar and shortcuts all read it.
components.api: VK.actions.register(a), forSurface(id, ctx), run(id), search(q), bindKeys(), keyLabel()

components.name: button
components.summary: Buttons: outline/primary/ghost/quiet/danger, icon, small, pressed; segmented .vk-btn-group.
components.api: CSS only

components.name: mini
components.summary: The MINI: every feature's icon that is also its button and its progress indicator (ring/ticks/square meter, states).
components.api: VK.mini.create(o), VK.mini.set(el, {progress, state, value, pressed}), VK.mini.fromAction(id)

components.name: shell
components.summary: Full-screen app frame: CSS grid (top bar, left/right/bottom docks, main, status bar); docks collapse to a rail of minis; HUD mode (data-mode=hud) turns the frame transparent over content with glass bars and panels; auto-collapse when narrow.
components.api: VK.shell.mount(el, {mode, docks:{left:{collapsed,size},right,bottom}, autoCollapse (default 480), touchCollapse (default 1100), onChange}) → {toggle(side, open?), collapsed, setSize, setMode, toggleMode, mode, state, refreshRails, destroy}; VK.shell.actions(sh, {prefix, at, keys}) → [<prefix>.hud, <prefix>.dock.left|right|bottom]

components.name: commandbar
components.summary: Top command bar: brand emblem slot, breadcrumbs as buttons, a search trigger that runs registry action palette.open when registered, minis from surface toolbar:command; container-query responsive. Minis that do not fit go behind a "…" overflow menu.
components.api: VK.commandbar.mount(el, {brand:{name,tag,emblem}, path:[{label,icon,mono}], onNavigate(i,seg), surface, searchAction, searchText}) (narrow: surplus minis → "…" menu) → {setPath, setBrand, refresh, render, path, destroy}

components.name: statusbar
components.summary: Bottom status bar rendering registry surface statusbar as minis + short mono text (action.statusText / statusSide / statusPin) plus passive readouts, start/end groups, polite role=status live region for state changes.
components.api: VK.statusbar.mount(el, {surface, label, items:[{id,key,text,side,pin}]}) → {refresh(id?), setText(id, text, announce?), announce, render, destroy}

components.name: panel
components.summary: Dockable panel: header with micro label, condensed title and minis (collapse, maximise, float, close, registry verbs, state), scrolling body, data-vk-hop; works in docks and floating (pointer drag, Ctrl+arrows).
components.api: VK.panel.mount(el, {title, label, icon, level, controls:[collapse,maximize,float,close], surface, collapsed, onCollapse, onMaximize, onFloat, onClose}) → {collapse, toggle, maximize, float, close, open, setTitle, setState({state,progress,label}), isCollapsed, refresh, destroy}; VK.panel.get(el)

components.name: splitter
components.summary: Resizable split view, horizontal or vertical, nestable: role=separator with aria-valuenow/min/max, arrows / Ctrl+arrows / PageUp/PageDown / Home/End, Enter or double-click resets, min sizes, onChange for persistence.
components.api: VK.splitter.mount(el, {orientation:horizontal|vertical, value, default, min:[a,b], step, bigStep, label, onChange(v)}) → {value, set, reset, destroy}

components.name: tabs
components.summary: Tablist with closable tabs, dirty dot (warm), overflow scroll with chevrons, roving keyboard (arrows, Home/End, Delete closes), registry minis (e.g. Új lap), tabpanels, empty state.
components.api: VK.tabs.mount(el, {tabs:[{id,label,icon,dirty,closable,panel}], active, activation, surface, emptyText, onSelect, onClose}) → {add, close, closeActive, select, next, setDirty, setLabel, active, ids, refresh, destroy}; VK.tabs.actions(t, {prefix, when}) → close (mod+w), next, prev

components.name: wm
components.summary: Window manager for the VRG Desktop: floating non-modal role=dialog windows, pointer drag/resize, edge snap, focus/z-order, minimise to a taskbar of minis (progress per window), maximise, snap halves, tile all, keyboard move/resize mode.
components.api: VK.wm.mount(area, {taskbar, glass, sheetBelow (default 480: full-width sheets), onChange}) → {open({id,title,icon,tag,content,x,y,w,h}), close, minimize, restore, maximize, snap, tile, cycle, move, resize, setProgress, setTitle, focus, active, list, get, destroy}; VK.wm.actions(wm, {prefix, when, keys}) → move, resize, minimize, maximize, snapLeft, snapRight, tile, cycle, close

components.name: kbd
components.summary: Keycap chips from registry keys, Alt-held key-hint badges over visible [data-action] elements, searchable cheat-sheet dialog (and inline sheet).
components.api: VK.kbd.chip(key), chips(keys), forAction(a), label(k), aria(k), hints({root, delay}) → off, showHints/hideHints, sheet(opts), renderSheet(el, opts), attachHelp({keys, at}) → actions 'help.keys' + 'help.hints'

components.name: menu
components.summary: Context / dropdown menus and a menubar from registry surfaces: groups with separators, disabled with reason, checkable, danger, key hints, submenus (children / many), typeahead, VK.place flipping, overflow '…' on the menubar.
components.api: VK.menu.open(surfaceOrItems, anchorOrPoint, ctx, {label, side, focus, restore, inline}) → {close, focusFirst, focusLast}; VK.menu.close(); bindContext(el, surface, ctxFn) → off; button(btn, surface, opts) → off; menubar(el, [{label, surface}], opts) → {layout, destroy}

components.name: palette
components.summary: Command palette (Ctrl+K): glass modal combobox, fuzzy hits highlighted, grouped, recent first, toggles BE/KI, running minis, 'Nem érhető el most' for disabled-only matches, prefix providers ('#' jump). Inline mount for docs.
components.api: VK.palette.attach({surface, keys, at, label}) registers 'palette.open'; open(text) · close() · toggle() · isOpen(); addProvider(prefix, fn(q, ctx) → [{label, hint, icon, run}], {label, placeholder}) → off; mount(el, {query, surface}) → {setQuery, refresh, destroy}

components.name: toolbar
components.summary: Registry surface 'toolbar:<id>' as minis or labelled buttons: roving arrows, group separators, dropdowns for children, ResizeObserver overflow into 'Továbbiak', toggleable placement top/bottom/left/right/floating via registry actions + onPlacement.
components.api: VK.toolbar.mount(el, {id, mode:'mini'|'label', placement, placeable, placementAt, onPlacement(p, xy), name, ctx}) → {refresh, rebuild, layout, setPlacement(p, xy), placement(), setMode(m), destroy}

components.name: graph
components.summary: SVG node/wire topology: bubble/dot/junction/terminal/hex nodes, metro/curve/straight wires typed by layer (planned dashed, active warm flow, arrows, labels, bundled fan-in/out), dashed chamfered frames, selection (click, Ctrl+click, Shift+box, Ctrl+A), keyboard spatial focus, layer show/hide with a legend of toggle minis, flat or iso-board projection (extruded slabs, glowing hub). Emits vk:selection.
components.api: VK.graph.mount(el, {nodes, edges, frames, layers, projection:"flat"|"iso", label, edgeStyle, arrows}) → {setData, select(ids,{add,toggle}), selection, focusNode, fit, zoomTo(k|id), zoomBy, panBy, centerOn, getView, setView, setLayerVisible(id,on), isLayerVisible, setProjection, bounds, model, legend(el), on(select|focus|open|rename|badge|view|layer|data), destroy}; registry ids: graph.zoomIn, graph.zoomOut, graph.fit, graph.delete

components.name: minimap
components.summary: Overview of a graph with the ice viewport rectangle: click/drag to move, arrows pan, +/- zoom, 0 fit; follows pan/zoom, selection and layer changes. .vk-minimap--overlay[data-corner=bl|tr] floats it on the stage.
components.api: VK.minimap.mount(el, graphInstance, {label}) → {update, destroy}

components.name: layerstack
components.summary: Stacked isometric planes; dashed vertical pillars tie the same entity across planes, warm beacons rise from active entities; plane list of show/hide/solo minis; hover/focus lights an entity on every plane; keyboard Up/Down plane, Left/Right entity, S solo, H hide.
components.api: VK.layerstack.mount(el, {planes:[{id,name,color}], entities:[{id,label,at:{planeId:{x,y}},beacon}], links}) → {setData, setVisible(id,on), solo(id|null), focus(planeId,entityId), highlight(id), state, on(focus|open|visibility), destroy}

components.name: timeline
components.summary: Swimlane timeline: sticky lanes, session bars / commit dots / release squares with run states, Nap/Hét/Hónap zoom, today marker, draggable ice playhead, roving-grid keyboard, registry actions as MINIs.
components.api: VK.timeline.mount(el, {lanes, items, from, to, zoom, now, playhead, follow, actions}) → {setRange, setPlayhead, setZoom, zoomIn, zoomOut, setFollow, setItems, select, focusItem, scrollTo, refreshActions, state, on, destroy}

components.name: eventrail
components.summary: Film-HUD event rail: chamfered band, year/age axis, warm pips, metro leader lines to row-stacked labels (date · [kategória] · text), id chips with warning glyph, ice selection.
components.api: VK.eventrail.mount(el, {from, to, events:[{t, label, cat, id, flag}], now, axis, born, maxRows}) → {setEvents, select, layout, on, destroy}

components.name: heatgrid
components.summary: Contribution pixel grid weeks × days (H K Sze Cs P Szo V), --vk-heat-0…4, legend, multi-year stack with totals, role=grid keyboard (day/week/month), live readout, select event.
components.api: VK.heatgrid.mount(el, {years, data, unit, levels, now, title}) → {setData, select, focusDate, on, destroy}

components.name: scrubber
components.summary: Time scrubber / range slider: ticks + date labels, play/pause MINI showing playback progress, step buttons, role=slider with date aria-valuetext, optional two-thumb range.
components.api: VK.scrubber.mount(el, {min, max, value, range, step, bigStep, duration, time, disabled}) → {set, get, play, pause, toggle, playing, setBounds, setDisabled, on, destroy}

components.name: table
components.summary: Dense data table (role=grid): sort (aria-sort), global + per-column quick filters (number expressions), sticky header and first column, click/Ctrl/Shift and Space/Shift+Space/Ctrl+A/Esc selection, roving cell, status cells via render(), zebra, loading/error/empty states, footer counts.
components.api: VK.table.mount(el, {columns, rows, selectable, onSelect, onActivate, onRefresh, tools, stickyFirst, zebra}) → {setRows, getSelection, select, selectAll, clearSelection, sort, filter, setState, getView, focus, refresh, destroy}

components.name: tree
components.summary: Treeview (WAI-ARIA tree): expand/collapse, arrows, typeahead, * expands siblings, icons by kind, tri-state checkboxes, lazy children with a loading/error MINI and retry, metro indent guides.
components.api: VK.tree.mount(el, {items, checkboxes, lazy, icons, onSelect, onActivate, onCheck, onToggle}) → {setItems, expand, collapse, expandAll, collapseAll, select, focusItem, getSelected, getChecked, setChecked, focus, destroy}

components.name: filemanager
components.summary: Dual-pane Total Commander style file manager: breadcrumb path bars, dense lists (name/ext/size/date), active pane in ice, warm marks, Tab pane switch, Enter/Backspace navigation, Insert/Space marking, F-key bar rendered from a registry surface (fkeys) with a MINI per key, status line.
components.api: VK.filemanager.mount(el, {provider(path) → entries|Promise, left, right, rootLabel, surface: "fkeys", onOpen}) → {cd, up, refresh, getActive, getOther, getTargets, mark, clearMarks, setStatus, refreshKeys, switchPane, focus, destroy}

components.name: card
components.summary: Cards (title + mono id + minis, body, meta row, footer, status edge) and selectable tile grids (listbox, 2-D roving): tile, compact tile, program tile whose icon sits in a MINI meter for launch progress.
components.api: VK.card.create({title, id, minis, body, meta, footer, status}) → el · VK.card.tile({id, icon, title, sub, value, unit, kind, status}) → el · VK.card.tiles(el, {multi, activateOnClick, onSelect, onActivate}) → {getSelection, select, setState, update, destroy}

components.name: inspector
components.summary: Key-value inspector: collapsible groups, mono values with units, inline edit (Enter/Esc, F2), copy value via a MINI (done/error), read-only (lock) and changed (warm dot) states; one tab stop.
components.api: VK.inspector.mount(el, {sections:[{title, collapsed, fields:[{key, label, value, unit, type, options, editable, readonly, changed}]}], onChange}) → {setData, set, get, getChanged, resetChanged, edit, destroy}

components.name: diff
components.summary: Line diff (LCS; unified and side-by-side; + − ~ markers and colour, intra-line highlight, context folding, N/P J/K change navigation) and a drift list (expected vs actual) with per-kind counts in filter MINIs.
components.api: VK.diff.mount(el, {a, b, mode, labels, context}) → {setText, setMode, next, prev, getStats, destroy} · VK.diff.drift(el, {items, labels, show, onActivate}) → {setItems, filter, next, prev, getCounts, destroy} · VK.diff.lines(a, b)

components.name: badge
components.summary: State badges: lifecycle (használatban/kész/fejlesztés alatt/tervezett/ötlet) and run state (aktív/várakozik/parkolva/lezárva), each with its own glyph shape; outline/solid/dot variants, sm/md/lg; aktív pulses (still halo under reduced motion).
components.api: <span class="vk-badge" data-state="inuse|built|dev|planned|idea|active|waiting|parked|ended" data-variant="solid|dot" data-size="sm|lg">; VK.badge.create(state, {variant, size, label, glyphOnly}), VK.badge.set(el, state), VK.badge.STATES/LIFECYCLE/RUN

components.name: signal
components.summary: Signal markers ellentmondás/hiány/fagyott: inline marker, node-corner flag, count chip; own icon and own frame each (hatched / dashed / double).
components.api: VK.signal.marker(kind, text), VK.signal.flag(kind), VK.signal.flags(host, kinds), VK.signal.count(kind, n), VK.signal.setCount(chip, n)

components.name: progress
components.summary: Progress: linear bar (determinate, indeterminate, done/error/paused, tick scale, sizes), segmented, stepped with labels (vertical under 360 px), thin inline meter with warn/crit; role=progressbar|meter with aria-valuetext.
components.api: VK.progress.create({label, value|null, max, text, variant:"segments", segments, scale, size, unit}), VK.progress.set(el, value|null, {text, state}), VK.progress.meter({label, value, max, warn, crit, tone}), VK.progress.steps({label, steps, current, error}), VK.progress.step(el, i, {error})

components.name: loader
components.summary: Loader sheet (own drawing, CSS): ring, dots, fade, ball, clock, bars; role=status + hidden text; a still meaningful frame under reduced motion; .vk-loader-sheet grid.
components.api: VK.loader.create(kind, {label, size:"sm|md|lg|xl", decorative})

components.name: toast
components.summary: Toast stack: info/ok/warn/error/activity, title+text+action, auto-dismiss counted down on the close MINI ring (pauses on hover/focus), Esc dismisses the focused toast, max N visible + queue, six positions, page or contained stack, activity toasts with progress.
components.api: VK.toast.show({kind, title, text, source, action, timeout, progress}) → {update, dismiss}; VK.toast.configure({position, max}), focusLatest(), clear(), count(); VK.toast.stack(container, opts) → same API. Suggested actions: toast.focus (Alt+T), toast.clear

components.name: notify
components.summary: Notification board + RING: radial SVG timeline, peaks by time, height and cap shape by severity, warm activity / crit errors, read dashed; unread count in the centre; ring peaks and board items roving and linked by selection; Ma/Tegnap/Korábban groups; registry toolbar as MINIs; bell MINI.
components.api: VK.notify.mount(el, {items, now, span, toolbar, label, onSelect, onChange}) → {add, remove, markRead, markAllRead, clear, select, selected, items, unread, setFilter, filter, mini, refresh, destroy}. Suggested actions: notify.read, notify.readAll, notify.unreadOnly, notify.clear

components.name: state
components.summary: Empty / loading / error blocks: reticle mark, mono code, title, text, primary + secondary action (registry ids); inline and panel sizes; error role=alert, loading role=status.
components.api: <div class="vk-state" data-kind="empty|loading|error" data-size="panel">; VK.state.create({kind, size, icon, code, title, text, action, secondary, loader})

components.name: readout
components.summary: HUD stat block (own drawing): corner brackets, micro label with №, big mono value, tick ruler with triangle marker and warn/crit zones (role=meter), cross-tally over a stacked bar, status list with badge glyphs; Papír theme gets a black title bar.
components.api: VK.readout.create({label, code, tag, tagTone, value, digits, unit, delta, min, max, warn, crit, ticks, tally, list}), VK.readout.update(el, partial)

components.name: field
components.summary: Form fields: label, help, error (aria-invalid + aria-describedby), required mark, text, number with mono unit suffix, textarea, native styled select, custom-drawn checkbox/radio (tri-state), prefix icon/text, readonly, disabled, inline vs stacked, fieldset, responsive form row grid.
components.api: CSS .vk-field/.vk-field__box/__input/__unit/__choice, .vk-fieldset, .vk-field-grid · VK.field.setError(input, msg|null), VK.field.tristate(parent, children), VK.field.mountAll(root) ([data-vk=tristate]), VK.field.number(input)

components.name: question
components.summary: Decision cards: title, one line of context, lettered options A/B/C (A = Ajánlott), free-text Más option; letters choose, arrows move (radiogroup), Enter confirms; answered = one compact line; stack with progress MINI (2/4) and copy MINI producing 1A 2C 3B.
components.api: VK.question.mount(el, {questions:[{id,title,context,options,recommended,other,answer}], onAnswer, title}) → {answers, line, copy, focus, reopen, set, destroy}; suggested action question.copyAll

components.name: rename
components.summary: Inline rename: F2 or double-click turns a label into an input in place (same metrics), stem selected without extension, Enter commits, Esc cancels, blur commits; empty/forbidden-char/duplicate validation in a popover tied by aria-describedby.
components.api: VK.rename.attach(listEl, {item, label, names(), validate(name), onCommit(item, name, old), onCancel}) → {start(item), destroy}; VK.rename.start(labelEl, opts) → {commit, cancel}; suggested action item.rename

components.name: search
components.summary: Search field: clear button, Hungarian-folded matching (otodik → Ötödik), grouped results with counts and highlighted hits, ARIA combobox + listbox with aria-activedescendant, arrows/Enter/Esc, no-results state, recent searches, async provider shown on the search MINI.
components.api: VK.search.mount(el, {provider(q) → groups|Promise, recent, onPick(item, group, q), label, placeholder}) → {query, open, close, clear, recent, focus, destroy}; VK.search.match(q, text), VK.search.filter(items, q)

components.name: chip
components.summary: Chips: filter (aria-pressed, tick + ice frame, wire swatch), removable (Delete/Backspace, sensible focus), count chips, roving focus, + add chip opening an inline input; group MINI = active filter count, click resets.
components.api: VK.chip.mount(el, {label, chips:[{id,label,kind:filter|remove|count,pressed,count,color}], add:{label,validate,onAdd}, onChange, onRemove}) → {add, remove, get, set, pressed, reset, mini, destroy}

components.name: slider
components.summary: Single and range slider (two non-crossing thumbs), ticks with labels, mono readout with unit, role=slider + aria-valuetext, arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End, pointer drag, disabled, vertical variant; MINI shows position.
components.api: VK.slider.mount(el, {label, unit, min, max, step, bigStep, value | values:[a,b], ticks, labels, vertical, disabled, format, onInput, onChange}) → {get, set, disable, mini, destroy}

components.name: toggle
components.summary: Switch (role=switch): label left/right, sizes sm/md/lg, disabled, busy (aria-busy, spinning warm arc while a Promise applies, clicks wait), error revert; MINI mirror.
components.api: VK.toggle.create({label, hint, checked, size, labelSide, disabled, block, onChange(on) → Promise|false}) · enhance(btn) · mountAll(root) · set(t, {checked, busy, disabled, error}) · get(t) · mini(t, {icon, caption})

components.name: chat
components.summary: Agent side chat: header with status mini, role=log messages (prose, inline code, fenced mono code with copy mini), collapsible tool-call blocks, thinking indicator, auto-growing composer with attach mini and context chips; SEND mini turns into STOP/progress while streaming; empty state with suggested prompts.
components.api: VK.chat.mount(el, {agent, model, status, suggestions, chips, messages, onSend(text, {chips, instance}), onStop, onAttach}) → {add(msg), update(id, patch), stream(id, chunk), end(id), setBusy(on, progress), addChip, removeChip, chips, clear, focus, send, stop, setStatus, registerActions(prefix), destroy}

components.api: VK.contextTray.mount(el, {title, format, collapsed, items, onSend(pack, tray), onChange}) → {add, set, remove, clear, move, items, pack(format), tokens, setCollapsed, setPreview, setFormat, setSending(p|null|"done"|"error"|false), copy, send, registerActions(prefix), destroy}; VK.contextTray.bindSelection(tray, resolver, {mode, accept}) → unbind; VK.contextTray.estimate(n)

components.name: trace
components.summary: Agent activity trace: steps (planned → running → done/error) on a vertical rail of minis, nested collapsible tool calls with leader lines (args, result excerpt, mono duration), node state chips, timestamps, retry, filter (Összes/Eszközhívások/Hibák), auto-follow mini, run mini; role=log over a keyboard tree.
components.api: VK.trace.mount(el, {title, run, follow, steps, onSelect(step), onRetry(step), onRun}) → {add(step), update(id, patch), addTool(stepId, call), updateTool(stepId, toolId, patch), expand(id, open), setFilter, setFollow, setRun, clear, steps, registerActions(prefix), destroy}

components.summary: Console pane: role=log scrollback with token-mapped tones (ok/warn/crit/info/muted/accent/strong) and ANSI SGR, prompt with history, Tab completion hook, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+C, copy selection mini, running-command mini (progress), progress lines; commands are registry actions on a surface.

components.summary: Generative city map on canvas from a seed or data rows [{name,size,heat,group}]: figure-ground, transit (octilinear pipelines, ring hubs, moving jobs) and iso styles; organic commit-by-commit buildup with a play/pause MINI; keyboard pan/zoom/play/reseed; registry actions citymap.*.
